**Coaching note (80 words):**
When your opponent's queen is hanging, always look for forcing moves first—especially checks and captures. Here, Black's queen on e5 attacks your queen, but you can turn the tables by playing Qxe5+, which wins Black's queen with check. After the forced king move (Kxe5 or Kf3), you're up huge material. The lesson: when under attack, look for counterattacks with forcing moves. A check that wins material is almost always the answer.
